result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with sidewalks and a marked, though faded, crosswalk. The environment is dominated by a wide one-way roadway and large-scale structures like a parking garage, which prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: A vehicle parked close to the intersection on the right side obstructs the sightlines between pedestrians and turning traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the curb

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Replace the faded transverse lines with continental-style markings to increase visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane urban street with a marked continental crosswalk and a sidewalk in good condition. However, the wide crossing distance and lack of pedestrian signals or refuge islands increase exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the crosswalk may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane urban thoroughfare that is highly hostile to pedestrians due to the lack of marked crossings and significant crossing distances. While sidewalks are present, the absence of curb ramps and pedestrian signals at this location creates a high-risk environment for those attempting to traverse the roadway.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cover a vast distance without any refuge or markings, increasing exposure to high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway spanning from left to right

hazards.name: Lack of ADA Accessibility
hazards.description: The sidewalk terminates at a high vertical curb with no ramp, making the crossing inaccessible for people with mobility aids.

hazards.name: Unmarked Pedestrian Crossing
hazards.description: There are no visual cues for drivers to expect pedestrians, and no designated path for walkers to cross the wide street.

interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.
